summary: Replaces the roster-load dates recorded as ownership start dates in Quail Ridge, Waterview, Still Creek and Canyon Gate (2,332 listed current ownership periods). 1,216 get the Fort Bend CAD deed date where the county roll matches one parcel, the owner name agrees and the date passes validation (basis county_deed: recording evidence, not a confirmed closing date); 1,116 become NULL (unknown, before trustEd history). Every change is recorded in the new append-only ownership_start_date_corrections with the prior date, reason and county evidence. property_ownerships.start_date becomes nullable; ownership_tenures gains start_date_basis. No owner, contact, account number, end date, balance, ledger row, GL entry, proposal or home sale changes. Unblocks the pending Waterview transfer 0f146aca (settlement 2026-05-04).

preflight.name: 553 not applied yet (no start_date_basis column, no corrections table)
preflight.sql: SELECT ((SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'ownership_tenures' AND column_name = 'start_date_basis') + (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'ownership_start_date_corrections'))::int

expected_changes: property_ownerships.start_date allows NULL (not known; before trustEd history).
ownership_tenures gains start_date_basis (settlement / county_deed / unknown) with a check constraint.

New append-only table ownership_start_date_corrections (association_record): one row per corrected period with the prior date, corrected date or NULL, reason and county evidence; service_role read only.
2,332 listed current ownership periods: 1,216 start on the county deed date (basis county_deed), 1,116 start NULL (basis unknown). Their open ownership rows get the same start.
No owner, contact, account number, end date, balance, ledger row, GL entry, proposal or home sale changes; no start date outside the list changes.

verify.name: 2,332 corrections: 1,216 county deed dates, 1,116 cleared to unknown
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::text || '/' || count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'county_deed_date')::text || '/' || count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'cleared_unknown')::text FROM ownership_start_date_corrections

verify.name: by community (deed dates/cleared): CG 441/279, QR 38/63, SCR 182/162, WV 555/612
verify.sql: SELECT string_agg(k, ' ' ORDER BY k) FROM (SELECT CASE community_id WHEN 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003' THEN 'CG' WHEN 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005' THEN 'QR' WHEN 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006' THEN 'SCR' WHEN 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' THEN 'WV' ELSE 'OTHER' END || ':' || count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'county_deed_date') || '/' || count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'cleared_unknown') AS k FROM ownership_start_date_corrections GROUP BY community_id) x

verify.name: no current period in the four communities still starts on a roster-load date
every corrected period matches its record and its basis
